text:
### Mission  
Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
name: Chunk 44/102

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Requirement Adherence
raw_entities.description: A foundational compliance obligation requiring the organization to ensure adherence to all applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies. This represents a core governance principle that underpins all operational and control activities.
context: Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies

raw_entities.name: Internal Policy Compliance
raw_entities.description: An operational constraint requiring the organization to maintain compliance with its own internal policies and procedures. This ensures consistent application of governance standards across all business units and functions.
context: Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies
